title: 从英文中重建数字
summary: 给定若干英文数字零到九的字母打乱串，按升序还原其中所有数字。
insight: z、w、u、x、g 分别唯一确定 0、2、4、6、8，再从其他特征字母中减去已知数字即可解出剩余项。
pitfalls: 输入保证可由数字英文组成
相同数字可能出现多次

solutions.title: 唯一字母逐步消元
solutions.idea: 统计字母频次后按依赖顺序求每个数字出现次数。
steps: 先由 z,w,u,x,g 求偶数项

code.java: class Solution { public String originalDigits(String s){int[] letters=new int[26],count=new int[10];for(char c:s.toCharArray())letters[c-'a']++;count[0]=letters['z'-'a'];count[2]=letters['w'-'a'];count[4]=letters['u'-'a'];count[6]=letters['x'-'a'];count[8]=letters['g'-'a'];count[3]=letters['h'-'a']-count[8];count[5]=letters['f'-'a']-count[4];count[7]=letters['s'-'a']-count[6];count[1]=letters['o'-'a']-count[0]-count[2]-count[4];count[9]=letters['i'-'a']-count[5]-count[6]-count[8];StringBuilder answer=new StringBuilder();for(int digit=0;digit<10;digit++)for(int i=0;i<count[digit];i++)answer.append(digit);return answer.toString();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun originalDigits(s:String):String{val letters=IntArray(26);val count=IntArray(10);for(c in s)letters[c-'a']++;count[0]=letters['z'-'a'];count[2]=letters['w'-'a'];count[4]=letters['u'-'a'];count[6]=letters['x'-'a'];count[8]=letters['g'-'a'];count[3]=letters['h'-'a']-count[8];count[5]=letters['f'-'a']-count[4];count[7]=letters['s'-'a']-count[6];count[1]=letters['o'-'a']-count[0]-count[2]-count[4];count[9]=letters['i'-'a']-count[5]-count[6]-count[8];val answer=StringBuilder();for(digit in 0..9)repeat(count[digit]){answer.append(digit)};return answer.toString()} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: string originalDigits(string s){array<int,26> letters{};array<int,10> count{};for(char c:s)++letters[c-'a'];count[0]=letters['z'-'a'];count[2]=letters['w'-'a'];count[4]=letters['u'-'a'];count[6]=letters['x'-'a'];count[8]=letters['g'-'a'];count[3]=letters['h'-'a']-count[8];count[5]=letters['f'-'a']-count[4];count[7]=letters['s'-'a']-count[6];count[1]=letters['o'-'a']-count[0]-count[2]-count[4];count[9]=letters['i'-'a']-count[5]-count[6]-count[8];string answer;for(int digit=0;digit<10;++digit)answer.append(count[digit],char('0'+digit));return answer;} };
